To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the regional innovation system is a complex entity that can be described by the innovation capability model, and that innovation capability can be modeled in a regional context by using partial least squares structural modeling.
networking, marketing, knowledge absorption, development and business renewal capabilities influence innovation capability.
networking and marketing are the key factors of innovation capability, which are positively related to knowledge absorption, development and business renewal capability.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the modeling of innovation capability in the regional context.
the development of the innovation capability model, which is based on the analysis of the relationships between the innovation capability components in the regional context.
the development of the regional innovation capability, which is a prerequisite for the development and growth of the regional economy.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the innovation capability in a given regional context is a function of networking, marketing, knowledge absorption, and development capability.
the regional innovation capability is not only a function of individual firms, but also the result of a collective process of interaction and cooperation between firms.
the innovation capability is a complex concept, and its modeling is not a trivial task.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the regional innovation capability is an important element in the process of regional development.
the regional innovation system is an important element in the innovation process and that the development of innovation capabilities is a complex process.
the model developed in this paper is useful for decision makers in regional context.
The main takeaway from our work is that

it provides new insights into the relationships between innovation capabilities and innovation performance in a regional context, as well as the importance of knowledge absorption capability for innovation performance.
the model of innovation capability can be successfully used in a regional context, and that it can help to understand and explain innovation capabilities in a more complex way.

it provides an opportunity for managers and policy makers to better understand the interrelations between innovation capability dimensions and to develop appropriate strategies to enhance the innovation capability.
